title: Teacher-written poem 'The Mountain Wakes'
subject: English

intro: 'The Mountain Wakes'. Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

passage.title: Teacher-written poem for TGA
paras: Deep in its belly the mountain grumbles,
its stony shoulders shrug and shake.
the sleeping giant starts to wake.
It coughs a cloud as grey as ashes,
it spits out sparks like angry bees,
and glowing rivers, slow as honey,
creep down to the trembling trees.

questions.model: I do: say them aloud: rumble sounds like rumbling, so it is onomatopoeia.

questions.a: the trees are shaking, as if afraid

questions.q: Which two words rhyme in stanza 1?
highlight and label one simile, one onomatopoeia and one personification
questions.model: I do first: 'the mountain grumbles': a mountain cannot grumble, so it is personification.

questions.q: explain in two sentences what 'It coughs a cloud' makes you picture
questions.a: For example: the volcano pushes out smoke like a person coughing; it sounds sudden and ill.

questions.q: which line is most powerful? Explain with because
questions.a: For example: 'spits out sparks like angry bees' because sparks sound fast and stinging
